catalogName: Catálogo de referencia de ajustes WinUtil
note: Catálogo completo de referencia de la sección Tweaks de WinUtil. Los nombres y descripciones proceden del archivo de configuración de origen. Los controles siguen deshabilitados hasta implementar una acción propia, validada y reversible en Rivero.

tweaks.name: Activity History - Disable
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from publishing or uploading user activities while preserving clipboard history.

tweaks.name: Hibernation - Disable
tweaks.description: Hibernation is really meant for laptops as it saves what's in memory before turning the PC off. It really should never be used.

tweaks.name: Widgets - Remove
tweaks.description: Removes the annoying widgets in the bottom left of the Taskbar.

tweaks.name: Start Menu Previous Layout - Enable
tweaks.description: Bring back the old Start Menu layout from before the gradual rollout of the new one in 25H2. On newer versions of Windows !!THIS TWEAK WILL NOT WORK!!

tweaks.name: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
tweaks.description: Will not display recommended Microsoft Store apps when searching for apps in the Start menu.
tweaks.sourceName: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable

tweaks.name: Location Tracking - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables Location Tracking.

tweaks.name: Services - Set to Manual
tweaks.description: Sets some services to Manual startup.

tweaks.name: svchost.exe Splitting - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables service-host splitting to reduce the number of svchost.exe processes and modestly lower memory overhead. Recommended for low-performance systems with 12 GB of RAM or less. Can interfere with Xbox services. Restart Windows after changing this setting.

tweaks.name: Brave Browser - Debloat
tweaks.description: Disables various annoyances like Brave Rewards, Leo AI, Crypto Wallet and VPN.

tweaks.name: RDP Unsigned File Warnings - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables warnings shown when launching unsigned RDP files introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.

tweaks.name: Microsoft Edge - Debloat
tweaks.description: Disables various telemetry options, popups, and other annoyances in Edge.

tweaks.name: ConsumerFeatures - Disable
tweaks.description: Stops promoted app installs and reduces app suggestions from Microsoft Store content.

tweaks.name: Telemetry - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables Microsoft Telemetry.

tweaks.name: Delivery Optimization - Disable
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from using your bandwidth to upload updates to other PCs on the internet or local network.

tweaks.name: Microsoft Edge - Remove
tweaks.description: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge by creating dummy MicrosoftEdge.exe file in the legacy Edge folder. This tricks Windows into unlocking the official Edge uninstaller allowing for a system-level removal.

tweaks.name: BitLocker - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables BitLocker.

tweaks.name: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC
tweaks.description: Essential for computers that are dual booting. Fixes the time sync with Linux systems.
tweaks.sourceName: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC

tweaks.name: Microsoft OneDrive - Remove
tweaks.description: Denies permission to remove OneDrive user files, then uses its own uninstaller to remove it and restores the original permission afterward.

tweaks.name: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable
tweaks.description: Removes the Home and Gallery from Explorer and sets This PC as default.
tweaks.sourceName: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable

tweaks.name: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance
tweaks.description: Sets the system preferences to performance. You can do this manually with sysdm.cpl as well.
tweaks.sourceName: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance

tweaks.name: Disable Reserved Storage
tweaks.description: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7-10 GB held for updates/temp files). Recommended only on small drives. Re-enable before major Windows feature updates to avoid installation failures.

tweaks.name: Restore Point - Create
tweaks.description: Creates a restore point at runtime in case a revert is needed from WinUtil modifications.

tweaks.name: End Task With Right Click - Enable
tweaks.description: Enables option to end task when right-clicking a program in the taskbar.
tweaks.sourceName: End Task With Right Click - Enable

tweaks.name: Storage Sense - Disable
tweaks.description: Storage Sense deletes temp files automatically.

tweaks.name: Windows AI - Disable And Remove
tweaks.description: Removes and disables all AI features/packages

tweaks.name: Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) - Disable
tweaks.description: If enabled, WPBT allows your computer vendor to execute programs at boot time, such as anti-theft software, software drivers, as well as force install software without user consent. Poses potential security risk.

tweaks.name: Prevent Device Companion Apps
tweaks.description: Prevents additional software from being installed when plugging in devices (e.g. Ads when plugging in a monitor). Poses potential security risk.

tweaks.name: Razer Software Auto-Install - Disable
tweaks.description: Blocks ALL Razer Software installations. The hardware works fine without any software.

tweaks.name: Logitech Download Assistant Auto-Install - Disable
tweaks.description: Blocks the Logi Download Assistant that Windows Update keeps reinstalling with Logitech device drivers. Logitech hardware keeps working without it.

tweaks.name: System Tray Notifications & Calendar - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables all Notifications INCLUDING Calendar.

tweaks.name: Adobe URL Block List - Enable
tweaks.description: Reduces user interruptions by selectively blocking connections to Adobe's activation and telemetry servers. Credit: Ruddernation-Designs

tweaks.name: Right-Click Menu Previous Layout - Enable
tweaks.description: Attempts to restore the classic Windows 11 File Explorer context menu on newer builds. Compatibility may vary.

tweaks.name: Disk Cleanup - Run
tweaks.description: Runs Disk Cleanup on Drive C: and removes old Windows Updates.

tweaks.name: Temporary Files - Remove
tweaks.description: Erases TEMP Folders.

tweaks.name: IPv6 - Set IPv4 as Preferred
tweaks.description: Setting the IPv4 preference can have latency and security benefits on private networks where IPv6 is not configured.

tweaks.name: Teredo - Disable
tweaks.description: Teredo network tunneling is an IPv6 feature that can cause additional latency, but may cause problems with some games.

tweaks.name: Windows Search Indexing - Disable
tweaks.description: Stops and disables the Windows Search service (WSearch) to cut background disk activity, mainly useful on mechanical hard drives. Warning: file searches in Explorer and the Start menu become much slower because Windows no longer maintains a search index. Undo restores the service and starts it again.

tweaks.name: IPv6 - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables IPv6.

tweaks.name: Background Apps - Disable
tweaks.description: Disables all Microsoft Store apps from running in the background, which has to be done individually since Windows 11.

tweaks.name: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
tweaks.description: Windows Explorer automatically tries to guess the type of the folder based on its contents, slowing down the browsing experience. WARNING! Will disable File Explorer grouping.
tweaks.sourceName: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable

tweaks.name: BSoD Verbose Mode
tweaks.description: Gives more information when you blue screen.

tweaks.name: System Tray Battery Percentage
tweaks.description: Shows numeric battery percentage next to the battery icon in the system tray.

tweaks.name: Dark Theme for Windows
tweaks.description: Dark Mode for the system and applications.

tweaks.name: File Explorer File Extensions
tweaks.description: Shows .file extensions in Explorer (.exe, .png, etc.)

tweaks.name: File Explorer Hidden Files
tweaks.description: Reveals hidden files in Explorer.

tweaks.name: Logon Verbose Mode
tweaks.description: Show detailed messages during startup/shutdown.

tweaks.name: Microsoft Outlook New Version
tweaks.description: This will ensure the new Outlook application is used.

tweaks.name: Scrollbars Always Visible
tweaks.description: If enabled, scrollbars will always be visible. If disabled, Windows will automatically hide scrollbars when not in use.

tweaks.name: Multiplane Overlay
tweaks.description: Multiplane Overlay composes multiple image layers, which can sometimes cause issues with graphics cards. Changes to this preference are applied immediately.

tweaks.name: Mouse Acceleration
tweaks.description: Makes it so Cursor movement is affected by the speed of your physical mouse movements.

tweaks.name: Num Lock on Startup
tweaks.description: Toggle the Num Lock key state when your computer starts.

tweaks.name: Window Snapping
tweaks.description: Toggles the window snapping feature when dragging windows.

tweaks.name: S0 Sleep Network Connectivity
tweaks.description: Toggles network connectivity during S0 Sleep which is low power idle in modern laptops.

tweaks.name: S3 Sleep
tweaks.description: Toggles between Modern Standby and S3 Sleep, which cuts off power to the CPU while continuing to refresh the memory.

tweaks.name: Settings Home Page
tweaks.description: Toggles the Home Page in the Windows Settings app.

tweaks.name: Start Menu Bing Search
tweaks.description: Toggles Bing web search results in Windows Search.

tweaks.name: Logon Screen Acrylic Blur
tweaks.description: Toggles the acrylic blur effect on login screen background.

tweaks.name: Lock Screen - Disable
tweaks.description: Skips the lock screen entirely and goes directly to the sign-in screen on boot and wake.

tweaks.name: Start Menu Recommendations
tweaks.description: Toggles the recommendations section in the Start Menu. WARNING: This will also disable Windows Spotlight on your Lock Screen as a side effect.

tweaks.name: Sticky Keys
tweaks.description: Toggles the Sticky Keys, which activate when clicking shift rapidly.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Centered Icons
tweaks.description: Toggles the Taskbar alignment either to the left or center.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Search Icon
tweaks.description: Toggles the Search Button on the Taskbar.

tweaks.name: Taskbar Task View Icon
tweaks.description: Toggles the Task View Button in the Taskbar.

tweaks.name: Game Mode
tweaks.description: Toggles Windows prioritizes gaming performance by allocating system resources to games.

tweaks.name: Enable Long Paths
tweaks.description: Toggles support for file paths longer than 260 characters in Explorer.

tweaks.name: O&O ShutUp10++ - Run
tweaks.description: Downloads O&O ShutUp10++ (about 82 MB) from oo-software.com on every click and launches it. Nothing is installed; the file is saved under %LocalAppData%\winutil.

tweaks.name: DNS - Set to:
tweaks.description: Sin descripción disponible en el archivo de origen.

tweaks.name: Ultimate Performance Profile - Enable
tweaks.description: Sin descripción disponible en el archivo de origen.

tweaks.name: Ultimate Performance Profile - Disable
tweaks.description: Sin descripción disponible en el archivo de origen.
